Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the "Analysis of Previous Result" section of its second turn. It completely ignored the evidence provided by WebSurfer, which clearly identified the 1950 film "Madeleine" as a British film directed by David Lean. Instead, the Planner hallucinated information about a different film ("Madeline" from 1952, an animated short) and incorrectly concluded that Robert (Bobe) Cannon was the director of the 1950 film. This led to an incorrect final answer.
